# `Q-10-4` — Recursive Partial

> A `$partial(name)$` reference ultimately includes itself,
> forming a cycle.

## What this means

Pandoc-flavored templates can use partials, and a partial may
itself include other partials. The template engine builds the
include graph at compile time and requires it to be acyclic —
a partial that depends on itself would expand forever. This
error fires when a cycle is detected.

## Why this happens

Two common causes:

- **Self-inclusion**, often introduced by an editing mistake:
  a partial includes itself.
- **A transitive cycle**: partial A includes B, B includes C,
  C includes A. Often the result of a refactor that split one
  partial into several.

## How to fix

Break the cycle. Inline one of the partials at the edge of the
cycle, or restructure so no partial ultimately depends on
itself.
